name: Domain Shift to Linear Algebra
description: The problem's core constraint (a parity check on sums) was replaced with a linear independence check on 2D vectors. Since the only two available vectors are linearly independent of each other but linearly dependent with themselves, this logically reduces to the exact same inequality constraint ($s_u \neq s_v$). Models relying on pattern matching will likely misclassify this as a computational geometry or linear algebra problem, while models that logically reduce the constraints will correctly identify the bipartite graph structure.
